rights.statement: Retain per-record component rights. Sharing a map does not relicense its data.

verification.displayManifest: SHA256 of exact upstream bytes and matching source manifest hash
verification.displayArchive: Expected SHA256 recorded; the 33.96 GB archive is not rehashed by the browser
verification.originalFiles: Flat upstream keys may be replaced; pinned processing must verify expected bytes and fail if unavailable
verification.geometryIndex: Every original shard byte length, SHA256, row count and finite full-geometry envelope verified. This index does not certify topology or real-world provider completeness.
verification.rowGroups: 5,512 contiguous original row ranges with verified whole-geometry envelopes; large-shard SHA256 rechecked and physical Parquet row groups used. Smaller files retain a complete logical range.

schema.nullSemantics: A null attribute means not recorded; it is distinct from false and zero.

coverage.requestCompletion: Task completion measures successfully read source parts and processed records, not real-world provider completeness.
coverage.sourceOwnership: Browser and native processing retain whole geometries intersecting the exact study boundary, including touching outlines. Candidate files use SHA256-bound full-geometry envelopes verified against all 3,522 original shards.
